# Chunker test fixtures

Short notes used by `tests/test_chunker_fixtures.py`.

| File | What it stresses |
|------|------------------|
| `keyword_dense.md` | Rare tokens (`ZYPHERON-9`, `KWLOSS-ALPHA-77`) — keyword loss |
| `semantic_shift.md` | Two topics under headings — semantic / topic mixing |
| `mixed_structure.md` | Lists, wikilinks, fenced code |
| `claim_units.md` | One-sentence claims — claim-centered chunking |

Keep these tiny and free of personal data.
